title: 税务透明度
summary: 评估公司税务策略透明度、避税风险与国别报告披露水平。

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Tax Transparency Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how our outputs are determined. Tax Transparency is a Key Issue in the Governance Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their estimated corporate tax gap (see below), revenue-reporting transparency and their involvement in tax-related controversies.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍税务透明度关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解评估结果的形成方式。税务透明度属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型治理支柱下的关键议题。公司评估涵盖估算企业税负差额（见下文）、收入报告透明度，以及涉及税务相关争议的情况。

blocks.content: A company's estimated tax gap will only affect its 0-10 Corporate Behavior Theme Score and its 0-10 Governance Pillar Score when it is involved in an ongoing tax-related controversy. Because the estimated tax gap is an approximation and does not consider the unique circumstances of a company's tax structure, ongoing tax controversies are used to improve the level of conviction in an estimated negative tax gap.
blocks.content_cn: 公司的估算税负差额，仅在涉及持续中的税务相关争议时，才影响其 0—10 分的企业行为主题得分和 0—10 分的治理支柱得分。由于估算税负差额是近似值，未考虑公司税务结构的独特情况，因此使用持续税务争议，提高对负税负差额估算结果的确信程度。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to Section 2, Data, ratings and scores, of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 有关 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 2 节“数据、评级与得分”。

sections.title_cn: 税务透明度关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Key Issue Score is based on the following Key Metric using the methodology described in Section 3.5.4, Calculating Governance Scores, of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 关键议题得分根据《ESG 评级方法论》第 3.5.4 节“治理得分计算”所述方法，基于以下关键指标计算。

blocks.content: The Key Metric evaluates a specific aspect of a company's governance risk profile.
blocks.content_cn: 该关键指标评估公司治理风险状况的一个具体方面。

blocks.content: Estimated effective tax rate: the estimated rate of taxes actually paid, based on the five-year annual average effective tax rate.
blocks.content_cn: 估计有效税率：基于五年年度平均有效税率，估计公司实际缴纳税款对应的税率。

blocks.content: Estimated statutory tax rate: the estimated total rate payable based on the countries and regions from which the company derives revenue.
blocks.content_cn: 估计法定税率：根据公司收入来源国家和地区，估计公司应缴税款对应的总税率。
